32g Protein
3g Sugar
150 calories
Lactose free

We believe we’ve created the best Ultra-Filtered Protein Shake on the planet, and now that we’re both fighting for the same team, we truly believe the sky is the limit.”

- Bradley Martyn & Logan Paul #primepartners".
